author: vW4n
content: Plan: 1) cargo update for in-range bumps (Cargo.lock only). 2) Audit Cargo.toml for major-version upgrades worth taking — sqlx, axum/0.7->0.8, redis, base64, k256, p256, image, validator, jsonwebtoken/10 etc. Skip risky majors (axum has breaking middleware/extractor changes between 0.7 and 0.8). 3) cargo fmt --all. 4) cargo clippy --all-targets — fix anything actionable; record any deferrals.
